summary: Brightstar Lottery PLC, a UK-domiciled NYSE-listed foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing open-market repurchases under its $500 million program announced July 1, 2025. It bought 370,200 ordinary shares delivered October 30, 2026 at $9.23-$9.60, and 173,681 shares delivered November 4, 2026 at $9.48-$10.24, totaling 543,881 shares for $5,207,078.40, held in treasury. No board recommendation or advisor named. The buyback reduces share count; watch remaining authorization capacity, pace of repurchases, and liquidity/overhang effects.
